create_fully_convolutional_model: create a fully convolutional sparse neural network model for 3D semantic segmentation using SparseConvNet
train_sparseconvnet_model: train a sparse convolutional network with SGD optimizer and cross-entropy loss over configurable epochs
compute_iou_metrics: compute intersection-over-union metrics across categories and CAD model parts for segmentation evaluation
store_batch_predictions: store batch predictions and ground truth labels aggregated by category and file for segmentation stats
checkpoint_save_load_model: checkpoint and restore a trained model's state dict and epoch counter from saved torch files
